output.summary: Roughly hairy perennial herb native to most of Europe, western Asia and northern Africa. Its sap may cause burns or rashes in sensitive people when contaminated skin meets sunlight. Pickled stems, leaves and flower clusters were historically used in an early form of borscht; young shoots are foraged and dried seeds used as a spice.
